secrets.name: BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Discord bot token from the Discord Developer Portal (Bot → Reset Token). Required for the bot to log in to Discord; a placeholder in .env.base44-defaults only lets the stack boot.

secrets.name: PLUGINS_LAVASRC_SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Optional — Spotify app client id, only needed to play Spotify links (LavaSrc).

secrets.name: PLUGINS_LAVASRC_SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Optional — Spotify app client secret, only needed to play Spotify links (LavaSrc).

secrets.name: PLUGINS_LAVASRC_DEEZER_ARL
secrets.description: Optional — Deezer ARL cookie, only needed to play Deezer links (LavaSrc).

secrets.name: PLUGINS_LAVASRC_DEEZER_MASTER_DECRYPTION_KEY
secrets.description: Optional — Deezer master decryption key, only needed to play Deezer links (LavaSrc).

secrets.name: PLUGINS_YOUTUBE_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN
secrets.description: Optional — YouTube OAuth refresh token, used to avoid YouTube bot detection (Lavalink YouTube plugin).
